notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Corrected an issue and now Contingency Plan can land critical hits.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Confounding Flash now has a cast visual. The casting visual is now more Holy oriented than Arcane and the sounds have been updated to match.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Starshards now correctly gains resistance to spell pushback from the Twilight Focus talent.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Dark Sacrifice no longer breaks Crowd Control that breaks on damage.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Dark Sacrifice’s tooltip now correctly displays that the Mana gained from the ability scales with Spirit.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Changed Eureka on every class to a 10% discount on Mana, Rage, or Energy abilities.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Changed the Will to Survive visual to match Dispel Magic instead of Will of the Forsaken.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Changed the Will to Survive visual to match Dispel Magic instead of Will of the Forsaken.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Cultivation now has a player-level requirement for every Herb. The level required is equal to the Herb’s level required to pick it divided by 5. Herbs that require a higher than 300 Herbalism skill to pick can be Cultivated at player level 60.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Eureka! no longer benefits periodic effects at all. Channeled spells do not count as periodics.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Cannibalize cannot be used if the caster is immune to Physical damage.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Eureka does not affect every Damaging Spell or Healing Spell for some classes. This is fixed in a later build.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Fixed an issue where Will of the Forsaken could sometimes not be used while asleep or charmed.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Endurance: Now grants 2% increased critical damage and healing (was 1% hit chance).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Plainsrunning: Also grants 3% increased mounted movement speed. This increase stacks with other mounted movement speed increases.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Cultivation: Cooldown reduced to 15 minutes (was 60 minutes).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: War Stomp: Cooldown reduced to 90 seconds (was 2 minutes).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Mace Specialization: Replaced with Earth Fury: 2% increased critical damage and healing.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Find Treasure: Now also grants a chance to find additional items in most chests.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Wind Blessed: Haste bonus increased to 3% (was 1%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Skysight: Now castable while moving.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Read Leyline: Now castable while moving. Minimum duration increased to 30 seconds (was 20 seconds).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Walk on Air: Cooldown reduced to 90 seconds (was 2 minutes).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Sword Specialization: Replaced with Ruthless: 2% increased critical strike chance.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Axe Specialization: Replaced with Savage: 1% increased critical strike chance.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Blood Fury: Cooldown increased to 3 minutes (was 2 minutes).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Shatter Curse: Now dispels Curses and Banes (was granting immunity). Magic damage taken reduced by 5% (was 15%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Touch of the Grave: Proc chance and cooldown adjusted to make benefit more consistent. Improvements made to visuals.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Undead will no longer have Will of the Forsaken available to them while under the effects of Scatter Shot.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Eureka!: Now an 8 second buff with no charges. Same effect on damage and ability costs. Now also benefits Power Word: Shield.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Eureka! cannot correctly be used while in stealth or invisibility.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Quickness: Movement speed increase now stacks with other movement speed increases.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Regeneration: Health regeneration bonuses increased to 20% (was 10%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Twin Disciplines now correctly benefits Shadow Word: Death, Mind Flay, Starshards and Penance.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Ruthless now increases critical chance by 1% (was 2%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Human Spirit now increases Spirit by 10% (was 5%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Earth Fury (2% increased critical strike damage and healing) removed.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Added: Artisan’s Precision - Increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Plainsrunning now grants 2% movement speed per stack (was 1%), for a total max increase of 60% (was 30%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Plainsrunning no longer increases mounted movement speed.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Endurance no longer provides any modifiers beyond 5% increased Health (no hit chance or critical damage modifiers).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Savage removed (1% increased critical strike chance).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Command re-added, increasing Warlock and Hunter pet damage by 5%.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Wind-Blessed Haste bonus reduced to 2% (was 3%).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Read Leyline now increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50% (was 100%), with a 15-second duration. This ability cannot be used while Innervate is active, and will be replaced by Innervate as a more powerful effect.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Using Read Leyline at a Ley Line now also grants “Attuned” for 1 hour. While Attuned, the benefit of Read Leyline is increased to 100% regeneration increase. Attuned persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Skysight is now a 15% increased movement speed (was 10%), with a 15-second duration.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Using Skysight at an elemental convergence now also grants “Charged” for 1 hour. While Charged, the benefit of Skysight is a 30% movement speed increase. Charged persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Blood Fury’s cooldown reduced to 2 minutes (was 3 minutes).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Touch of the Grave internal cooldown reduced to 15 seconds (was 25 seconds).

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Charged persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.

notes.topic_title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 26
notes.author: Kaivax
notes.text: Attuned persists through death, and is removed upon entering a raid.
